invariants.rationale: It's a common precondition for methods accepting reference parameters to require non-null arguments unless explicitly allowed.
Nested ScrollPanes may not be intended; asserting that 'actor' is not itself a ScrollPane could prevent recursion or odd UI hierarchies.
This expresses that 'actor.isVisible()' is always defined and side-effect free, which may be important to ensure at this point.
Indicates that getParent() can be safely called, regardless of actual value.
Verifies that 'actor.getStage()' is always a valid call at this program point.
